title: HOLD-LC-001 event-day Fermi owner-artifact byte freeze and schema audit
question: Do exact event-day Fermi position/attitude and spectral-history owner candidates provide the missing source lineage needed to advance HOLD-LC-001 beyond generic metadata intake, without admitting a detector-to-geocenter conversion or timing likelihood?
method: Acquire exactly the event-day official Fermi GBM position/attitude history product and the N0/B0 spectral-history products from the 2017-08-17 daily directory into the gitignored cache.
Byte-freeze the three products with their official locators, roles, lengths and SHA-256 values in a tracked manifest; do not copy raw bytes into tracked contents.

Run the self-tested audit_hold_lc_owner_artifacts.py with a zero-axis-aware, quote-aware FITS parser. Verify hashes and inspect scalar headers/table declarations only, including extension names, required columns, time standard and coverage; read no table rows or values.
Repeat the byte, header, extension and required-column checks with an independent PowerShell parser.
Mutate the expected SHA-256 of a selected owner product and require the primary audit to return nonzero.

Keep likelihood, covariance, calibration-validity law, geocenter conversion, nuisance law, candidate maps, score and prospective credit stopped; preserve the established T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods and owner order.

exact_scope.extraction_scope: FITS scalar headers and table declarations only; no position, attitude, spectral-history, event or calibration row values, timing fit or score.
exact_scope.finite_scope: Finite exact owner-provenance and schema intake; no continuum, physical identity or prospective validation.
exact_scope.method_scope: Additive T-061 owner-artifact intake; no change to T-054/T-059 methods, owner order or promotion firewalls.

position_attitude.interpretation: Header/schema presence identifies an event-day position/attitude owner candidate, not the detector-to-geocenter conversion or its uncertainty.

spectral_history.interpretation: Header/schema presence identifies event-day gain/energy-resolution history owner candidates, not calibration validity, interpolation, response linkage or shared uncertainty.

checks.detail: Zero-axis FITS handling, block padding, quote-aware slash-in-string parsing and synthetic schema rules passed.
All three owner products match their frozen SHA-256/byte lengths; the position/attitude and both spectral-history schemas and TT-second coverage metadata match.
Independent PowerShell byte/hash/header parser returned hdu=2, coverage=2 and schema=True for all three products with the recorded hashes and lengths.
Changing the expected SHA-256 of FERMI-GBM-EVENT-DAY-POSHIST-ALL caused the primary audit to return nonzero; the selected mutation was rejected.
No T-054/T-059 authority, candidate card, result, negative, physical-empty input or Lean theorem was edited or promoted.

finding: The new event-day products cross the parked generic-owner-search boundary by supplying exact, hash-pinned GS-006 position/attitude and GS-005 spectral-history owner candidates with declared schemas and TT-second coverage. They sharpen the physical-owner request but do not supply the detector-to-geocenter conversion, calibration validity/interpolation, joint timing likelihood, covariance or intrinsic-emission nuisance law required for F_reg and scoring.
decision_reason: This is a new exact source locator and byte hash with an independent schema reproduction, not another generic metadata search. The result advances T-061 owner intake while retaining the explicit statistical-admission stop and all existing forward/inverse methods.
decision_scope: Finite retrospective owner-provenance and FITS schema extraction only; no event-level inference, candidate ranking, dynamic identification, empirical prediction or physical promotion.
assumptions: The owner-artifact byte-freeze manifest is authoritative for product identity, role, locator, hash and length.
FITS scalar headers and table declarations are descriptive provenance; no table value is interpreted.
The event-day products are an owner-candidate subset and not a complete multi-instrument timing/calibration pipeline.
The existing candidate-neutral estimator contract, T-054/T-059 methods, owner order and prospective-lock rules remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: Source-owned detector-to-geocenter timing conversion and uncertainty for each instrument and time window.
Calibration release validity intervals, interpolation rules and an explicit link from spectral history to the selected response products.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with selection semantics.
A source-owned joint timing likelihood or component/shared covariance including calibration and intrinsic-emission nuisance terms.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map and immutable scorer.
A prospective holdout not used for source selection, calibration choice or estimator design.

adversarial_review.check: Could position/attitude headers be treated as an already defined detector-to-geocenter correction and timing uncertainty?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: the audit records columns and coverage only; conversion, interpolation and uncertainty remain missing.

adversarial_review.check: Could the declared spectral-history table be treated as a complete calibration validity/interpolation law linked to the response?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: only schema and coverage metadata are admitted; row values, validity semantics and response linkage are not interpreted.

adversarial_review.check: Could exact public products be called source ownership of the complete timing likelihood?
adversarial_review.disposition: UPHELD-BLOCKED: physical-owner candidates are frozen, but likelihood, covariance and nuisance ownership remain absent.

adversarial_review.check: Could one position-history file and two spectral-history files be called a complete multi-detector estimator?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED-FOR-SCOPE: the packet labels the exact three-product intake subset and keeps all four map stages incomplete.

adversarial_review.check: Could this owner intake replace the established proof lanes?
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED: T-054/T-059, R-192 owner order and stopped-loop rules are unchanged.

boundary: EXP-001305 is a T0 source-owner candidate and schema advance. It does not admit a detector-to-geocenter conversion, timing likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map, candidate, score, prospective prediction, microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum result, Reading-H sign, Pre-A closure or mass-gap conclusion.
evidence_level: T0 exact byte/hash freeze, zero-axis-aware FITS schema extraction, independent PowerShell reproduction and hostile selected-hash rejection; no model test
next_action: Request or locate the validity, interpolation, detector-to-geocenter and uncertainty owner artefacts linked to these exact products. Do not interpret table rows or score candidates until the statistical owner and proof-owner fields are frozen; continue the unchanged T-054 owner intake in parallel.
stop_or_redesign: If no owner supplies conversion, validity and statistical objects, retain HOLD-LC-001 as provenance/design-only and do not score.
If a future audit reads table values, issue a new version with an explicit candidate-neutral selection, uncertainty and leakage contract.
If a temporal observable remains invariant over the declared static-equivalence class, report NONIDENTIFIABLE rather than selecting a representative.
If calibration, regulator or nuisance changes reverse a finite verdict, report UNSTABLE_FINITE_ONLY.
If the retrospective packet is used for tuning after target disclosure, do not award prospective credit.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted, selected, ranked, fitted or prospectively validated.
No source-owned detector-to-geocenter conversion, calibration-validity law, likelihood, covariance, nuisance probability law or complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map is present.
Exact public-product owner candidates do not establish a causal law, QFT/Yang-Mills/gravity identity or microscopic dynamics.
No physical vacuum, Reading-H branch, Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim is established.
The existing T-054 forward and T-059 inverse methods are unchanged; this audit is additive and not a replacement.
